metadata.title: Minimalist Surrealist Still Life with Musical Instruments

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, minimalist studio composition featuring musical instruments arranged in a surreal, geometric fashion against a clean white corner.
excludeWhen: busy or cluttered backgrounds are required
dark or moody lighting is requested
naturalistic or outdoor settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, bright studio space where a chrome chair and various wind instruments (pan pipes, organ pipes) are arranged to create dynamic diagonal lines and a sense of floating or gravity-defying placement.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal organ pipes pointing toward a central chrome chair
High-key white background defining a corner space
Contrast between metallic chrome, grey pipes, and warm wooden accents
Wide tracking in top-aligned sans-serif typography
coreInvariants: The presence of a chrome-framed chair with a woven seat as a central anchor.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A chrome chair sits in the lower-center foreground; large organ pipes enter from the edges at sharp angles.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The chrome chair acts as the primary stable element amidst the dynamic diagonals.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal pipes from the outer edges inward toward the chair and the top-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space creates a sense of airy, conceptual openness.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool Grey (organ pipes and chrome chair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Ochre/Yellow (pan pipes and decorative tassels)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall with small pops of saturated warm tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid heavy shadows or dark blacks
Limit palette to white, grey, and muted wood tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme letter-spacing for a modern, airy feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric proportions and clean lines.
Provides a similar classic British modernist feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio photograph of a white corner. In the center foreground, a chrome chair with a woven seat. Several large grey organ pipes enter the frame from the left, right, and top at diagonal angles. A hand holds yellow pan pipes on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text along the top edge, split into two groups justified to the left and right margins with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the background predominantly white and high-key?
Are the organ pipes positioned at dynamic diagonal angles?
Is the text uppercase with wide tracking at the top?
Is the chrome chair the central anchor?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Exact placement of the hand holding the pipes
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome texture on the chair is reflective.
Verify the text is perfectly horizontal and aligned to the top.
Check that the diagonal pipes create a sense of depth.
Confirm the white background is clean without distracting textures.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio corner + chrome furniture + diagonal geometric props + wide-tracked top-aligned sans-serif typography.
